title: INTERPRETING LANGUAGE REWARD MODELS VIA CONTRASTIVE EXPLANATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating contrastive explanations (counterfactuals and semifactuals) by perturbing the length and detail of language model responses to measure the reward model's global sensitivity and preference flip rate.

Generating contrastive explanations by perturbing the 'neutrality' of responses (explicitly defined as being without biases towards certain groups) to evaluate how often altering group neutrality causes the reward model's preference to flip.
